module.purpose: Provides a controlled dialog for collecting and submitting a six-digit email verification code. It coordinates digit-entry state, automatic submission after valid input, manual submission, pending/error presentation, and selection between verification callbacks depending on session requirements.
module.summary: This UI component renders a localized email-code verification dialog with six numeric inputs supplied by a digit-input hook. Input changes clear existing errors, while a side effect automatically submits a trimmed six-digit value when no prior verification, error, or pending state blocks it. Manual submission remains available through the footer button. The component chooses one of two caller-provided verification actions based on whether a user session is required, exposes pending state through the submit button, clears input when dialog state changes, and displays caller-provided verification errors.
module.businessContext: Supports email verification in booking-related user flows. Correct code collection and submission are necessary to validate an email or continue an authenticated booking flow; failures can prevent users from completing verification.
